name: Fire Hydrant
steps: Begin on all fours on a comfortable mat with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core engaged and your weight evenly distributed across both hands.
Maintaining a 90-degree bend in your right knee, lift your right leg out to the side like a dog at a fire hydrant.
Lift only as high as you can without tilting your pelvis or shifting your torso to the left.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower your knee back to the starting position.
coaching_cues: Resist the urge to lean your body weight heavily toward the supporting side.
Focus on contracting the outer glute and hip rotators.
Keep your spine neutral throughout the repetition.
